title: Libra: Large Chinese-based Safeguard for AI Content
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures general AI safety across seven harm scenarios: Physical and Mental Health, Privacy and Property, Ethics and Morality, Bias and Discrimination, Illegal Activities and Crime, Hate Speech and Abuse, and Rumors and Misinformation. It does not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion.
